svg.text: CP-SRA16-ELC-001 - Placement in the rack, cable routes
LEFT SECTION, looking at the left wall 1:8
P8-1 clip on the front-left rail spacer; probe across the plenum
P8-1 clip just above the shelf, tip over the hood outlet
lead in a P8-1 clip, board hanging free in the air
P8-1 clip on the rear-left rail spacer, rear face
P8-1 clip on the rear-left rail spacer, just above the return opening
6.5 mm hole in the elbow's outer bend, probe 25 mm in, silicone
on a small alu angle bonded to the tray, front-left corner
switch under the hood's front edge, magnet on the door lining
switch on the door lining at the hinge side, magnet on the side lining
stuck on the AC front over its IR receiver (by the display)
magnets on the front-left rail spacer, front face
outside the upper door, 2 x M4 rivnuts
P1-1 left end, 25 mm membrane grommet
300 mm loop in spiral wrap, between the hinges
x from the left skin, y back from the front, z up from the floor (rack_layout v1.2.0).
Cold side (blue): front plenum. Hot side (red): rear plenum and the bay above the partition,
which carries the return air down to the AC. Everything that crosses from the front plenum
to the bay goes through the hood port HP; no other holes are needed. Keep probe leads
50 mm from mains cords, tied but not tensioned, and out of the condenser intake.
W4 IR, W5 leak, W6 lower door, via HP
W2 rear harness: T6, T5, T4, UPS, mains
D25 through, wall thinned to 2 mm over D35
one hole per cable. Front face on the left.
6 mm probe snaps in from the top;
10 x 3 magnet glued in the base.
B HINGE LOOP, PLAN AT z 1450 1:6
300 mm of W1 in 10 mm spiral wrap runs
from the door grommet to a tie mount on
the side lining, inside the seal line and
half way between the hinges. Open the
door fully before tying off: no tension
when open, nothing pinched when shut.
Thin line: the cable with the door open.
